approved: Treasury Laws Amendment (More Cost of Living Relief) Bill 2025
Treasury Laws Amendment (More Cost of Living Relief) Bill 2025 - Second Reading - Put the question
Treasury Laws Amendment (More Cost of Living Relief) Bill 2025 - Second Reading - Agree with the bill's main idea

Moved the Treasury Laws Amendment (More Cost of Living Relief) Bill 2025, arguing it would reduce the first marginal tax rate from 16 per cent to 14 per cent over two years starting from July 2026, provide further relief to all 14 million taxpayers, and raise Medicare levy low-income thresholds by 4.7 per cent.
Withdrew amendments to the Treasury Laws Amendment (Tax Incentives and Integrity) Bill 2024 and the Treasury Laws Amendment (More Cost of Living Relief) Bill 2025.
